<?php
/**
 * Multi-tenant Logging Agent with JNI Bridge
 * Uses native Java bridge for high-performance log aggregation
 * 
 * Architecture: PHP Agent -> JNI Bridge -> Java Log Collector
 */

class TenantIsolationContext {
    private string $tenantId;
    private string $namespace;
    private int $securityLevel;
    
    public function __construct(string $tenantId, int $securityLevel = 1) {
        $this->tenantId = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $tenantId);
        $this->namespace = 'tenant_' . $this->tenantId;
        $this->securityLevel = max(1, min(5, $securityLevel));
    }
    
    public function getTenantId(): string { return $this->tenantId; }
    public function getNamespace(): string { return $this->namespace; }
    public function getSecurityLevel(): int { return $this->securityLevel; }
}

class JNIBridgeConfig {
    private string $jvmPath;
    private string $classpath;
    private array $jvmOptions;
    
    public function __construct(string $jvmPath, string $classpath, array $jvmOptions = []) {
        $this->jvmPath = $jvmPath;
        $this->classpath = $classpath;
        $this->jvmOptions = $jvmOptions;
    }
    
    public function getJvmPath(): string { return $this->jvmPath; }
    public function getClasspath(): string { return $this->classpath; }
    public function getJvmOptions(): array { return $this->jvmOptions; }
}

class NativeLogCollector {
    private $bridgeHandle;
    private TenantIsolationContext $context;
    private JNIBridgeConfig $config;
    private array $methodCache = [];
    private const REQUIRED_CROSS_TENANT_LEVEL = 4;

    // Protocol length-field limits for the JNI binary wire format.
    private const MAX_KEY_LENGTH = 65535;      // pack('n') is 16-bit unsigned
    private const MAX_VALUE_LENGTH = 0xFFFFFFFF; // pack('N') is 32-bit unsigned
    
    public function __construct(TenantIsolationContext $context, JNIBridgeConfig $config) {
        $this->context = $context;
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->initializeBridge();
    }
    
    private function initializeBridge(): void {
        $envDescriptor = $this->buildEnvironmentDescriptor();
        $this->bridgeHandle = $this->nativeInit($envDescriptor);
    }
    
    private function buildEnvironmentDescriptor(): string {
        $descriptor = [
            'tenant' => $this->context->getTenantId(),
            'namespace' => $this->context->getNamespace(),
            'jvm_path' => $this->config->getJvmPath(),
            'classpath' => $this->config->getClasspath(),
            'options' => $this->config->getJvmOptions(),
            'isolation_mode' => 'separate_classloader'
        ];
        return json_encode($descriptor);
    }
    
    /**
     * Resolves JNI method reference with tenant-scoped caching
     * Method signatures follow JNI descriptor format
     */
    private function resolveMethod(string $className, string $methodName, string $signature): string {
        $cacheKey = $this->context->getNamespace() . ':' . $className . '.' . $methodName;
        
        if (!isset($this->methodCache[$cacheKey])) {
            // Build the JNI method reference with tenant context
            $methodRef = $this->buildMethodReference($className, $methodName, $signature);
            $this->methodCache[$cacheKey] = $methodRef;
        }
        
        return $this->methodCache[$cacheKey];
    }
    
    /**
     * Constructs JNI method reference string
     * Format: <namespace>/<class>.<method>:<signature>
     */
    private function buildMethodReference(string $className, string $methodName, string $signature): string {
        // Tenant namespace is prepended for isolation
        $qualifiedClass = $this->context->getNamespace() . '/' . $className;
        return $qualifiedClass . '.' . $methodName . ':' . $signature;
    }
    
    /**
     * Invokes native method through JNI bridge
     * The shared JVM instance routes based on method reference prefix
     */
    public function invokeCollector(string $method, array $params): mixed {
        $methodRef = $this->resolveMethod(
            'com/logging/Collector',
            $method,
            $this->inferSignature($params)
        );
        
        $serializedParams = $this->serializeForJNI($params);
        return $this->nativeInvoke($this->bridgeHandle, $methodRef, $serializedParams);
    }
    
    /**
     * Cross-tenant log query - requires elevated security level
     * Used by admin dashboards for aggregate reporting
     */
    public function crossTenantQuery(string $targetTenant, string $query): mixed {
        // Enforce security level check on PHP side before any JNI call
        if ($this->context->getSecurityLevel() < self::REQUIRED_CROSS_TENANT_LEVEL) {
            throw new \RuntimeException(
                'Insufficient security level for cross-tenant query. ' .
                'Required: ' . self::REQUIRED_CROSS_TENANT_LEVEL . 
                ', Current: ' . $this->context->getSecurityLevel()
            );
        }
        
        $accessToken = $this->generateCrossTenantToken($targetTenant);
        
        $methodRef = $this->resolveMethod(
            'com/logging/CrossTenantBridge',
            'executeQuery',
            '(Ljava/lang/String;Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/Object;'
        );
        
        $params = $this->serializeForJNI([
            'token' => $accessToken,
            'target' => $targetTenant,
            'query' => $query
        ]);
        
        return $this->nativeInvoke($this->bridgeHandle, $methodRef, $params);
    }
    
    /**
     * Generates cross-tenant access token
     * Token encodes source tenant, target tenant, and permission scope
     */
    private function generateCrossTenantToken(string $targetTenant): string {
        $signingKey = $this->getSigningKey();
        if (empty($signingKey) || $signingKey === 'default-dev-key-do-not-use') {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid signing key configuration');
        }
        
        $tokenData = [
            'source' => $this->context->getTenantId(),
            'target' => $targetTenant,
            'level' => $this->context->getSecurityLevel(),
            'timestamp' => time(),
            'nonce' => bin2hex(random_bytes(16))
        ];
        
        $tokenPayload = base64_encode(json_encode($tokenData));
        $hmac = hash_hmac('sha256', $tokenPayload, $signingKey);
        
        return $tokenPayload . '.' . $hmac;
    }
    
    private function getSigningKey(): string {
        $key = getenv('AGENT_SIGNING_KEY');
        if ($key === false || $key === '') {
            throw new \RuntimeException('AGENT_SIGNING_KEY environment variable not set');
        }
        return $key;
    }
    
    /**
     * Serialize PHP values to JNI-compatible format
     * Uses a compact binary protocol for efficiency
     */
    private function serializeForJNI(array $params): string {
        $buffer = pack('N', count($params));
        
        foreach ($params as $key => $value) {
            $keyBytes = mb_convert_encoding((string)$key, 'UTF-8');
            $keyLen = strlen($keyBytes);
            // Validate key length fits the 16-bit length prefix to prevent
            // protocol desynchronization / truncation in the native parser.
            if ($keyLen > self::MAX_KEY_LENGTH) {
                throw new \LengthException(
                    'Serialization key exceeds maximum allowed length of ' . self::MAX_KEY_LENGTH . ' bytes'
                );
            }
            $buffer .= pack('n', $keyLen) . $keyBytes;
            
            if (is_string($value)) {
                $valBytes = mb_convert_encoding($value, 'UTF-8');
                $valLen = strlen($valBytes);
                if ($valLen > self::MAX_VALUE_LENGTH) {
                    throw new \LengthException(
                        'Serialization value exceeds maximum allowed length of ' . self::MAX_VALUE_LENGTH . ' bytes'
                    );
                }
                $buffer .= chr(0x01) . pack('N', $valLen) . $valBytes;
            } elseif (is_int($value)) {
                $buffer .= chr(0x02) . pack('J', $value);
            } elseif (is_array($value)) {
                $nested = json_encode($value);
                $nestedLen = strlen($nested);
                if ($nestedLen > self::MAX_VALUE_LENGTH) {
                    throw new \LengthException(
                        'Serialization nested value exceeds maximum allowed length of ' . self::MAX_VALUE_LENGTH . ' bytes'
                    );
                }
                $buffer .= chr(0x03) . pack('N', $nestedLen) . $nested;
            } else {
                $strVal = (string)$value;
                $strValLen = strlen($strVal);
                if ($strValLen > self::MAX_VALUE_LENGTH) {
                    throw new \LengthException(
                        'Serialization value exceeds maximum allowed length of ' . self::MAX_VALUE_LENGTH . ' bytes'
                    );
                }
                $buffer .= chr(0x01) . pack('N', $strValLen) . $strVal;
            }
        }
        
        return $buffer;
    }
    
    private function inferSignature(array $params): string {
        $sig = '(';
        foreach ($params as $p) {
            if (is_string($p)) $sig .= 'Ljava/lang/String;';
            elseif (is_int($p)) $sig .= 'J';
            elseif (is_float($p)) $sig .= 'D';
            elseif (is_array($p)) $sig .= 'Ljava/lang/Object;';
            else $sig .= 'Ljava/lang/Object;';
        }
        $sig .= ')Ljava/lang/Object;';
        return $sig;
    }
    
    // Native bridge stubs - implemented in C extension
    private function nativeInit(string $descriptor): mixed {
        if (function_exists('jni_bridge_init')) {
            return jni_bridge_init($descriptor);
        }
        return new \stdClass(); // Stub for testing
    }
    
    private function nativeInvoke(mixed $handle, string $methodRef, string $params): mixed {
        if (function_exists('jni_bridge_invoke')) {
            return jni_bridge_invoke($handle, $methodRef, $params);
        }
        return null; // Stub for testing
    }
}

/**
 * Agent entry point - processes incoming log events
 */
class LoggingAgent {
    private NativeLogCollector $collector;
    private TenantIsolationContext $tenantContext;
    
    public function __construct(string $tenantId, array $config = []) {
        $this->tenantContext = new TenantIsolationContext(
            $tenantId,
            $config['security_level'] ?? 1
        );
        
        $bridgeConfig = new JNIBridgeConfig(
            $config['jvm_path'] ?? '/usr/lib/jvm/java-17/lib/server/libjvm.so',
            $config['classpath'] ?? '/opt/logging-agent/lib/*',
            $config['jvm_options'] ?? ['-Xmx256m', '-Xms64m']
        );
        
        $this->collector = new NativeLogCollector($this->tenantContext, $bridgeConfig);
    }
    
    public function logEvent(string $level, string $message, array $metadata = []): void {
        $this->collector->invokeCollector('appendLog', [
            'level' => $level,
            'message' => $message,
            'metadata' => $metadata,
            'timestamp' => time()
        ]);
    }
    
    public function queryLogs(string $targetTenant, string $filter): mixed {
        return $this->collector->crossTenantQuery($targetTenant, $filter);
    }
}
